verdict.stance: Overweight / Net-Cash West African Tier-1 Gold Producer (9M26 EBITDA $2.25bn)
verdict.summary: Endeavour Mining swung into a $263m net cash position by Q326 ($849m cash vs $586m gross debt) after generating $1.16bn FY25 FCF and $2.25bn 9M26 YTD Adjusted EBITDA (+38% YoY). First-quartile gold mines in Côte d'Ivoire, Senegal, and Burkina Faso deliver massive coupon coverage on the $500m 7.00% May-30 notes.

positives: Balance sheet flipped to $263m NET CASH by Q326 ($849m cash vs $586m gross debt).
9M26 YTD Adjusted EBITDA $2.25bn (+38% YoY) following $1,156m record FY25 FCF.
Long-life, low-cost asset base (Ity, Houndé, Sabodala-Massawa, Lafigué) with $700m RCF liquidity.
negatives: West African sovereign & fiscal royalty risk (Burkina Faso mining code / Mali exit / Côte d'Ivoire royalty changes).
Gold price cyclicality vs AISC inflation ($1,433/oz in FY25).
